description: Move a page to a different position in the document

binding.description: Location of the binding spine in the spread (BindingOptions)

pageIndex.description: 0-based index of the page to move

position.description: Where to move the page: AT_END, AT_BEGINNING, or BEFORE/AFTER referencePage

referencePageIndex.description: 0-based reference page index (required for BEFORE/AFTER; must differ from pageIndex)

name: move_page
title: Move Page
